description: Sends page URLs to search engines. IndexNow is free and reaches Bing, Yandex, Seznam, Naver and Yep, not Google; it needs a key file on the site, which indexnow_key sets up and checks. Index My Site (indexmysite.app) is paid from the person's own credits: it sends URLs to Google, checks each, and gives a credit back for each page Google has not indexed by its final check. It never sends without confirm true, and only after the person saw the cost. Submitting asks for a crawl; it does not make a search engine index a page. Fix redirects, noindex, errors and canonicals first. Actions: indexnow_key (site: makes or reuses this site's IndexNow key, says which file to serve and checks whether it is live; key: use a key the site already serves), indexnow (urls on one host: checks the key file, then sends them to IndexNow, free; reaches Bing, Yandex, Seznam, Naver and Yep, not Google), indexmysite (urls, up to 2,000: Index My Site, paid with the person's own credits, sends them to Google, checks each after 24 hours and gives a credit back for each page Google has not indexed by the final check around day 14. Without confirm it only returns the cost and the balance and sends nothing; show the person that cost, then call again with confirm true. bing also sends each URL to Bing for 1 more credit, fast asks for faster Google indexing for 1 more; neither extra credit comes back. Use them only when the person asks), indexmysite_status (credits and recent jobs; with job_id every URL's status and what happens next), indexmysite_approve (job_id and url_ids or all: approves URLs held for review because little main content was found; costs credits, so confirm works as for indexmysite), indexmysite_connect (connects the person's Index My Site account with a browser sign-in).

all.description: indexmysite_approve: every URL waiting for approval, only when the person chose all of them.

bing.description: indexmysite, optional: also send each URL to Bing, 1 more credit per URL, not returned. Only when the person asks.

confirm.description: indexmysite and indexmysite_approve: true sends and spends credits. Without it the call returns the cost and sends nothing.

fast.description: indexmysite, optional: faster Google indexing, 1 more credit per URL, not returned. Only when the person asks.

job_id.description: indexmysite_status and indexmysite_approve: the job id.

key.description: indexnow_key and indexnow, optional: an IndexNow key the site already serves at /<key>.txt.

name.description: indexmysite, optional: a label for the job.

site.description: indexnow_key: the host or a URL on it, such as example.com.

url_ids.description: indexmysite_approve: the url_id of each URL the person chose.

urls.description: indexnow and indexmysite: full page URLs. indexnow takes one host per call.

name: seo_submit
title: Ask search engines to crawl pages
